verdict.rationale: The only discovery evidence is a generic "discover new sources" mention. Nothing shows searching scholarly databases, academic literature indexes, or primary-source archives as distinct from the open web. Uploading PDFs or Play Books ebooks the user already has is a user-side workaround, not scholarly search, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can search scholarly literature and primary sources, not just the open web
